text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm not falling for it anymore! 
I'm definitely exposing your trick this 
time, Fuji!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, back for more? By all means, I'll 
captivate you with my magic as many times 
as you like♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, enjoy acting cool while you still 
can. I brought some powerful backup today!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama? Well, that's a surprise... I 
never thought my magic would reach even 
you!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Not particularly. I just heard I could 
see the best card manipulation in the 
academy.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Besides, seeing through the trick has its 
own reward.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Ama's special reward... a bowl of 
spicy offal stew made by the Mom of Miho!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I see. If that's how it is, then allow me 
to be your opponent. I have my pride as an 
entertainer, after all!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hmph...! I see, quite the impressive 
skill. Delicate finger movements and 
clever misdirection—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... What passionate gazes. With 
expectations that high, I might end up 
working even harder than usual.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hah...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, you deliberately made them exhale 
just now, didn't you? I see, so you even 
control your opponent's breathing... huh.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Don't be so cold. Won't you look only into 
my eyes a little more? Right now, this 
showtime is just for you...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...Ngaah~ Fuji, wait up a sec!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hishi Ama? Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"No, sorry, but could we call this match 
off? Calling in someone else for a 
one-on-one duel... I'm starting to feel 
embarrassed."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for dragging you along, Nakayama... 
I'll bring over that promised motsuni stew 
later.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Tch, throwing cold water on me right 
when things were getting good. Though... 
fine, whatever."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Keep honing your skills, Fuji. ...Next 
time, I'll see right through you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, roger that— If you ever want to 
dream again, please come visit! ♪
